title: Global Zira Executive Workstation — 10' x 10'
body_html:
A complete 10' x 10' executive office in a single configuration — desk, returns, filing, and overhead storage that work together out of the box.

Built from Global's premium Zira laminate desking system, this executive workstation pairs a P-top island desk and connecting table return with a full storage wall: a 53" two-drawer file with doors, a 3-high open cabinet, end shelving, and box/box/file lower storage. A 23" hutch with horizontal pigeon-hole filing tops it off, and every surface is finished in thermally fused laminate available across the full Zira range. Made in Canada and tested to exceed ANSI/BIFMA standards.

Key features

  • Complete 10' x 10' executive office configuration built from the Global Zira desking system
  • P-top island desk with faux pedestal and connecting table return for an expansive primary worksurface
  • Integrated storage: 53"H two-drawer file with doors, 3-high open storage cabinet, end shelf and box/box/file lower storage
  • 23" high hutch with horizontal pigeon-hole storage for organized overhead filing
  • Mix-and-match Zira components allow the layout to be tailored to nearly any private-office floor plan
  • Tested to exceed ANSI/BIFMA standards and backed by Global's Limited Lifetime Warranty

Who it’s for

Executive and management private offices in municipal, education, and healthcare administration settings that need a complete, generously scaled 10' x 10' workspace.

Office Central and Brant Business Interiors are verified OECM partners, so Ontario’s public sector can buy without an open tender. Call 1-800-835-9565 for a quote.
